newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne backs Q2 EPS estimate of $0.17.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne backs Q2 EPS estimate of $0.17.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc Chief Executive Officer Craig Reynolds said on Wednesday he was "extremely comfortable" with a second quarter consensus earnings estimate of $0.17 per share.
He also reiterated that the company, which is the target of a hostile takeover bid from Invacare Corp, was not for sale because of its strong strategic internal growth plan.
Last week, Healthdyne rejected a sweetened $191 million, takeover offer from rival medical equipment maker Invacare.
The company said then it thought the $15 per share offer was still too low and did not represent fair value.
Reynolds told the Dillon Read analysts meeting that the Invacare bid had not gone up that much relative to the stock market's recent gains.
"The Invacare bid has gone up," Reynolds said, "but if you look at how its gone up relative to how the stock market has gone up, the bid really has not increased by that much."
Healthdyne also rejected previous Invacare offers of $12 and $13 per share. Invacare made the $15 per share bid on June 4 saying it was its "best and final offer."
